'''A. Drax''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[NewsNet]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]]. Drax reported on the Alliance [[Attack on the Imperial Army-Navy Ordnance Center|strike]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
